profile.note: Sampled whole-process CPU profile; includes the independent resvg replay outside the solve timer.

kernelsOnly.method: Serial alternating-order complete audits, including maps. Both policies are warmed once. Kernel load, input loading, comparison and hashing are outside each audit timer. Only elapsed time is excluded from exact output equality.

outlineIncrement.method: Serial alternating-order complete audits, including maps. Both policies are warmed once. Kernel load, input loading, comparison and hashing are outside each audit timer. Only elapsed time is excluded from exact output equality.

node.method: Serial alternating-order complete audits, including maps. Both policies are warmed once. Kernel load, input loading, comparison and hashing are outside each audit timer. Only elapsed time is excluded from exact output equality.

browserAudits.method: Same complete audit, including maps. Three rounds rotate policy order after one warmup for each policy and input. Loading, warmups and exact comparisons are outside audit timers. cachedJavaScript keeps the new outline reuse but disables the native paper kernels.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

weighted.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

limitations: Exact equivalence covers reported audit fields and maps for the recorded fixed geometries; separate kernel regressions compare distance fields and component labels.

Paper-audit timers include map creation but exclude kernel loading and explicit warmup; calibration of a new size bucket in the Node audit benchmark falls inside that bucket’s first measured audit. Whole-solve replays include normal startup.
The full fitter remains deadline-dependent; faster checks can change how much refinement or sharing runs, so final coordinates are not guaranteed identical.
The before/after full-solve batches were separate runs; only the paper-audit comparisons alternate policies on the same fixed inputs.
The guarded discrete paper model is not a physical tear-strength or assembly certificate.
